limits: Subtractive reuse is not bitwise-identical to separately accumulated masked propagation.

No empirical rank, correction or speed evidence.
bank_algebra.native_extra_independent_measurement: Native raw PX exists: S_O=PX-S_C and signed=2S_C-PX. One additional N×500 response suffices in real arithmetic.
